name: io.github.ThatMojo/encarapi-mcp
title: EnCarAPI - Korean & Chinese used cars
description: Live used car listings from South Korea (Encar, KB Chachacha, K Car) and China (Dongchedi, Che168).

environmentVariables.name: ENCARAPI_KEY
environmentVariables.description: EnCarAPI key (https://encarapi.com). Set this and/or CHINACARAPI_KEY.

environmentVariables.name: CHINACARAPI_KEY
environmentVariables.description: ChinaCarAPI key (https://chinacarapi.com). Set this and/or ENCARAPI_KEY.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional: Bearer <your EnCarAPI key>. Without it the server starts the OAuth flow (paste the key once in the browser).

headers.name: x-china-key
headers.description: Optional: a separate ChinaCarAPI key for the Chinese tools.
